[RFCS.15.3] **Emit rule.** When call recording is enabled ([RFCS.15.6]),
the encoder MUST emit exactly one `CallIssued` atom per `DS_EV_ACTION_CALL`
event. The engine emits that event once the call's arguments evaluate, before
the call callback runs, whatever the callback answers ([IDSP.6.5],
[IDSP.1.4]). **The engine emits the event, never the atom** ([IARC.1.14]); the
encoder (recording writer) encodes the `CallIssued` from it. A call the engine
refuses before that point — an argument that fails to evaluate, or a NaN
([LEXP.4.2]) — emits no event, hence no `CallIssued`.
